app_info.subtitle: Delegate local code work
app_info.description: codex2gpt lets ChatGPT inspect approved local workspaces, use bounded search and fetch, manage local Git worktrees, delegate coding tasks to Codex through a local MCP server, and render lightweight cards for threads, approvals, worktrees, and result bundles.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists configured local workspace metadata and does not modify files or state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads Git worktree metadata for an approved local workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only inspects local Git state and does not affect external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, remove, or alter worktrees.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a managed local Git worktree in an approved writable workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only local workspace state and does not publish or submit external changes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new managed worktree and branch without deleting or overwriting existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a managed local Git worktree in an approved writable workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only local workspace state and does not publish or submit external changes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removes a managed local worktree, which can discard files in that worktree.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns a bounded summary of an approved local workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads bounded text from a specific file inside an approved workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only runs bounded literal search over an approved local workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns standard search results for bounded matches in one approved local workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads bounded text for one document id returned by search.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks read-only Local Bridge Advisor access and fetches one bounded result from an approved workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only local approved workspace context with no external access.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, mutate workspace files, or start writable Codex work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists Codex app-server threads scoped to an approved workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only local Codex state and does not publish external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify files or Codex threads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a Codex thread that may modify approved writable workspace files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Delegates to local Codex app-server and may use configured Codex web search when explicitly enabled.
justifications.destructive_justification: May modify, overwrite, or delete files depending on the Codex task.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a Codex thread with read-only sandbox enforced for an approved workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Delegates only to local Codex app-server without enabling external web access.
justifications.destructive_justification: Forces read-only sandbox and cannot request workspace-write access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Resumes a Codex thread and may continue file-changing work.
justifications.open_world_justification: Delegates only to local Codex app-server for approved workspaces.
justifications.destructive_justification: May continue a task that changes workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a branched Codex thread record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only local Codex app-server state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete existing files or threads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads Codex app-server thread history.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local Codex state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate files or threads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends a new Codex turn that may perform local work.
justifications.open_world_justification: Delegates through local Codex app-server and may use configured Codex web search when explicitly enabled.
justifications.destructive_justification: May modify files depending on the requested turn.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds guidance to an active Codex turn.
justifications.open_world_justification: Delegates only through local Codex app-server.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not itself delete files or approve destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes running Codex turn state by interrupting it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only local Codex execution.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops work but does not delete files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads persisted app-server events.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local bridge state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate files or Codex state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a Codex review workflow in local app-server state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Delegates only to local Codex app-server.
justifications.destructive_justification: Review mode should inspect rather than delete workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists models exposed by local Codex app-server.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local Codex capability state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate files or Codex state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists local allowlisted run option preferences.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can enable Codex web search for future local Codex runs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a managed worktree and starts Codex execution inside it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes local Git and Codex state, and may use configured Codex web search when explicitly enabled.
justifications.destructive_justification: May modify files inside the managed worktree.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads Codex capability/configuration state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local Codex state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate files or Codex state.

justifications.read_only_justification: May list or deny a workspace-scoped pending Codex approval request.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends decisions only to local Codex app-server.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only deny decisions are accepted through MCP; approval allows stay outside model-controlled tools.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads thread history and redacted stored events.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local bridge and Codex state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate files or Codex state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists running background terminals for a Codex thread.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local Codex app-server state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not stop processes or mutate files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stops running background terminals for a Codex thread.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only local Codex-managed processes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops processes but does not delete workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Terminates one Codex-managed background terminal.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only local Codex-managed processes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops one process but does not delete workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes in-memory Codex thread context by rolling back turns.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only local Codex app-server thread state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can discard recent thread context and should be treated as destructive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes local Codex thread representation by compacting it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only local Codex app-server state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes local Codex thread archival state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only local Codex app-server state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete workspace files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes local Codex thread state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only local Codex app-server state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deletes a Codex thread record and should be treated as destructive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Restores an archived local Codex thread record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only local Codex app-server state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete workspace files or thread records.

test_cases.description: Search local workspace context and fetch a matching result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search my approved workspace for the code that starts Codex tasks and open the most relevant result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching local code results and fetches bounded text for the selected result.

test_cases.description: Inspect available workspace context before planning work.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the approved workspaces and give me a brief summary of the main project workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists approved workspace ids and returns a bounded top-level repository summary.

test_cases.description: Create a managed local worktree for isolated work.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a managed worktree named feature-a from main in the approved writable workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a managed local worktree and returns its workspace id, name, branch, base, and relative path.

test_cases.description: Start and steer an app-server-backed Codex thread.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start a new Codex thread in the approved workspace to investigate the test suite, then steer it to focus only on failing integration tests.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts a persistent local Codex app-server thread, applies non-approval guidance, and returns redacted streamed events scoped to the approved workspace.

test_cases.description: Resume, read, and export a Codex thread result bundle.
test_cases.user_prompt: Resume the Codex thread linked to this workspace, read the latest context, and export the result bundle with changed files and tests run.
test_cases.expected_output: Continues only a known or visible workspace-linked thread and returns a redacted bundle with thread id, final message, file changes, commands, tests, and status.

test_cases.description: Deny a pending Codex approval without allowing model-controlled approval.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show pending Codex approval requests for this workspace and deny the risky shell command.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists redacted pending approvals and accepts only an explicit deny action, leaving allow decisions outside model-controlled MCP tools.

test_cases.description: Complete ChatGPT OAuth discovery and resource-bound authorization.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect this local app from ChatGPT Developer Mode using OAuth for the MCP endpoint.
test_cases.tools_triggered: No MCP tool. Uses HTTP OAuth discovery, registration, authorization, and token routes before MCP calls.
test_cases.expected_output: Discovers protected resource metadata for /mcp, registers an allowed ChatGPT redirect URI, requires local approval, and issues a token only for the matching resource.

test_cases.description: Review and remove a managed local worktree.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the Git worktrees for the approved workspace and remove the managed worktree named feature-a.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists sanitized local worktrees and removes only the named managed worktree from the approved writable workspace.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar lookup is outside its supported local coding workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for email sending requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my team with the latest project update.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send messages or interact with email systems.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated shopping requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me the best price for a new pair of headphones.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because web shopping is outside its approved local developer-tool scope.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search all of my local files for API keys.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should reject the request unless it names an approved workspace and should not enumerate unrelated local files.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Approve any Codex command that is waiting so the task can keep going.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should refuse allow decisions through MCP and accept only deny actions for pending Codex approvals.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject OAuth authorization for a mismatched resource.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Authorize this app token for https://evil.example.test/mcp using the local bridge OAuth flow.
negative_test_cases.tools_triggered: No MCP tool. Uses HTTP OAuth authorization and token routes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should reject authorization or token exchange when the resource does not exactly match the local MCP endpoint.
